solutionSql:
SELECT id, COUNT(*)::integer AS copies
FROM staging_scans
WHERE id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY id;
ambiguities: A NULL id is not a scan id, so I excluded it with WHERE id IS NOT NULL. No dataset has a NULL id, so the result did not change.
notes: Corrected after the revised ticket text, which types the columns: id integer, copies integer. The earlier solution left COUNT(*) as bigint and this record said columnsMatchTicket true, which was wrong. The solution now casts COUNT(*) to integer, and the engine reports integer for both output columns on sample, nulls and boundary. Rows are unchanged: each dataset returns (1007, 2). Only scan 1007 repeats in every dataset. Confidence high.
